unit: The USA 1919-1948: The People and the State
title: The Great Depression and Hoover's response

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of the 1929 crash, the Great Depression's human impact and the limits of Hoover's response.

items.title: The Great Depression: Crash Course US History #33
items.description: John Green on the crash, bank failures, Hoovervilles and why Hoover's response fell so short. 13 min.

items.title: The Great Depression — America's Biggest Economic Crisis
items.description: Full documentary covering the causes and human toll of the Great Depression from 1929 to recovery. 45 min.

items.title: The Grapes of Wrath (1940)
items.description: John Ford's adaptation of Steinbeck's novel — Dust Bowl migrants fleeing to California is Depression America at its rawest.

items.title: Cinderella Man (2005)
items.description: Boxer James Braddock's true story of survival during the Depression — hope amid Hoovervilles and hunger.

items.title: Khan Academy — The Great Depression
items.description: Free articles and exercises on the Wall Street Crash, causes of the Depression and Hoover's policies.
